Hence his lack of interest in life.

On one occasion as a punishment for having failed an exam and having to repeat the course, his father sent him to some snowy mountains.

Due to misunderstandings and circumstances from the past - especially Reiji's jealousy and inferiority complex towards Shu - the two brothers often have a very hostile relationship. Shu still doesn't know that Reiji is to blame for the fire in Edgar's village; although he still doesn't know that Edgar survived and is Yuma Mukami.
